briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4 push multi-agent capabilities into production

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released three major models this week amid escalating US-China compute restrictions. Funding remains robust with multiple $1B+ rounds closed. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate reported incidents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 2.1T parameters showing 23% gains on agentic benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3.1 follow closely. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant while xAI scaled Colossus to 1M H100s.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC Arizona fab reached 2nm volume production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft announced $15B Stargate Phase 2 data center cluster in Texas. Google TPU v6 pods now exceed 100k chips per cluster.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory caps on training compute slow US labs more than Chinese competitors by Q4 2026?
